independent.summary: LEO-116's build step (2) instructs clearing `scanRules` on any unchanged URL the sweep did not credit this run, but on a rescrape unchanged pages are never swept at all (their chunks aren't rebuilt, so `sweepChunks` never sees them) — following the spec would erase valid findings from the previous full scrape on every nightly LeoRefresh, the opposite of the chip-persistence problem the item is filed to fix; 'did not trip' and 'was never looked at' are indistinguishable there, and the verify line ('a later rescrape where nothing trips clears both') encodes the same confusion.
